DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お車の保管場所について、お申込みでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you applying regarding the storage location for your car?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。同じ駐車場に家族の区画もあります。私の車を置く区画が分かるよう、持参した図を確認してほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 家族別区画が同駐車場にあり本人区画を示す持参図確認を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. My family also has a space in the same parking lot. I would like you to check the diagram I brought so it is clear which space my car will occupy.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for a check of your diagram showing your own space, since a family member has a separate space in the same lot. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご本人が使う区画を、こちらの図で示してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please indicate the space you yourself will use on this diagram.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 入口から見て左の十番です。右の十一番は兄が使います。二つを囲んだ図だったので、十番だけを示します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 入口左十番本人と右十一番兄を示し本人十番のみ囲む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: It is number ten on the left when viewed from the entrance. My older brother uses number eleven on the right. The diagram circled both, so I will indicate only number ten.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Indicate your own number ten on the entrance's left and your older brother's number eleven on the right, and circle only your own ten. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 入口と、十番の位置を確認できました。区画の寸法の記載もありますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: I can confirm the entrance and the location of number ten. The space's dimensions are also written here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 実際に測った幅と奥行きをここへ書きました。入口の幅は別の行にして、区画の寸法と区別しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 実測区画幅奥行きと入口幅を別記して説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I wrote the width and depth I actually measured here. I put the entrance width on a separate line to distinguish it from the space's dimensions.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that the measured space width and depth are recorded separately from the entrance width. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 持参書類の内容を確認します。こちらの申込欄も、ご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will check the documents you brought. Please also check this application section.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 氏名と車の情報を確認しました。所在地はこちらの記載で、区画は十番です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 本人車情報氏名所在地と十番区画を照合する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I checked my name and the car information. The address is as written here, and the space is number ten.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Cross-check your car information, name, location, and space number ten. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 書類を受け付けました。こちらが受付の控えです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: We have accepted your documents. Here is your acknowledgment copy.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 受け取りました。所在地と十番の区画が図で示せたので、この控えを保管して次の案内を待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 受付控えを受領し所在地区画の図示を確認して次案内を待つ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have it. Now that the location and space number ten are shown on the diagram, I will keep this copy and wait for the next instructions.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Receive the acknowledgment copy, confirm that the location and space are diagrammed, and wait for further instructions. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、お申込みを承りました。控えをお忘れなくお持ちください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then we have received your application. Please be sure to take your copy. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お会計の内容について、ご質問でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have a question about the payment details?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 発送の料金と買ったはがきの代金を一緒に払いました。発送の分だけ会社へ伝えるので、どの行か示してもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 送料と本人購入はがき合算会計の送料行を示すよう頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I paid the shipping charge and the price of the postcards I bought together. I will report only the shipping part to my company, so could you point out which line that is?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask which line shows shipping in a combined payment for shipping and your own postcard purchase. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらの行が発送の料金で、下の行がはがきの代金です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: This line is the shipping charge, and the line below is the postcard price.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 発送はこの金額ですね。合計全額を送料として伝える前に確認できてよかったです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 送料金額を確認し全合計を送料と報告しないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: So this is the shipping amount. I am glad I checked before reporting the entire total as shipping.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm the shipping amount and say you will not report the whole total as shipping. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 発送の料金が分かる控えも、お渡ししています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: We have also given you a slip showing the shipping charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 控えはこちらです。この金額が領収書の発送の行と同じか、一緒に見てください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 発送控えと領収送料行の金額照合を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Here is the slip. Please check with me whether this amount matches the shipping line on the receipt.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask to compare the shipping slip amount with the shipping line on the receipt. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 一致しています。二つの紙は、どちらもお持ち帰りいただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: They match. You can take both papers home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 二つを受け取ります。会社には発送の行を説明し、はがき代は私の買物として分けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 二紙を受領し会社送料と本人便用品代を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will take both. I will explain the shipping line to my company and separate the postcard price as my own shopping.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Receive both papers and separate company shipping from your personal postal-supply purchase. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ほかに会計の確認はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Is there anything else about the payment you want to check?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お釣りも合っていました。発送の金額を確認できたので、領収書と控えをそろえて持ち帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 釣銭一致も報告し領収書発送控えを一緒に持帰る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: The change was correct too. Now that I have confirmed the shipping amount, I will take the receipt and slip home together.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Report that the change is correct too and take the receipt and shipping slip home together. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご確認ありがとうございました。それでは、お忘れ物のないように。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for checking. Please be sure not to leave anything behind. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 貸金庫をご利用でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you using your safe-deposit box?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。今日は中の書類を二つ確認し、一つだけ持ち帰ります。利用の受付をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 既利用貸金庫で二書類確認一つ持帰りの利用受付を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. Today I will check two documents inside and take just one home. Please arrange access for me.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask to access your existing safe-deposit box to check two documents and take one home. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご本人とご利用の情報を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will confirm your identity and usage information.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 本人の資料と利用の案内を持ってきました。こちらです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 本人資料利用案内を提示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I brought my identification documents and the usage instructions. Here they are.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Present your identification documents and usage instructions. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 確認できました。書類を広げるための台も、利用する場所にあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: I have confirmed them. There is also a table for spreading out documents in the area you will use.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: その台で確認します。持ち帰る用の袋を一つ、自分で用意しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 利用台確認と本人持帰り袋の準備を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will check them on that table. I have prepared one bag myself for taking the document home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will use the table to check and have prepared your own bag for taking the document home. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 利用する場所へご案内します。確認が終わりましたらお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will show you to the area. Please let us know when you have finished checking.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 確認を終えました。二つのうち、今回必要な一つを袋へ入れ、もう一つは元の場所へ戻しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 二書類を確認し必要一つ袋収納残りを元位置へ戻したと報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have finished. Of the two, I put the one I need this time into the bag and returned the other to its original place.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Report that you checked both documents, bagged the needed one, and returned the other to its original place. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご利用を終える準備はできましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Are you ready to finish using the box?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。台に紙を残していないことを確認しました。持ち帰る袋は手元にあります。今日はここまででお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 台残置なしと持帰り袋保持を確認して利用終了を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I checked that I left no papers on the table. I have the bag to take home with me. Please finish my visit here for today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm no papers remain on the table and you hold your take-home bag, and ask to end the session. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご利用を終えました。それでは、書類をお忘れなくお持ち帰りください。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Your session is now complete. Please remember to take your document home. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お料理に添える物をお探しでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for something to accompany the meal?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人が夕食を作ります。私はおかずを一品持っていきたいですが、友人の献立をまだ聞いていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 友人夕食へ持参おかずの前に献立未確認と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: My friend is making dinner. I would like to bring one side dish, but I have not asked about my friend's menu yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you have not checked the menu before bringing a side dish to your friend's dinner. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 先に献立を確認すると、選びやすそうですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Checking the menu first should make choosing easier.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 連絡したら、主菜は魚の煮付けでした。同じ味の煮物を足すより、違う物を選びたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 煮魚献立の回答を得て味付けの重複を避ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I contacted my friend, and the main dish is simmered fish. I would rather choose something different than add another simmered dish with the same flavor.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Receive the simmered-fish menu reply and avoid duplicating the seasoning. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらの売場には、そのまま食べられる野菜の品もあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: This section also has vegetable dishes that are ready to eat.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: このサラダなら合わせやすそうです。ただ、友人が食べられない物も聞いてから決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: サラダを検討し友人の食べられない材料も聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: This salad looks easy to pair with it. But I will decide after also asking what my friend cannot eat.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Consider a salad and also ask which ingredients your friend cannot eat. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 商品の材料は、この表示でご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please check the product ingredients on this label.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 友人から、材料は大丈夫と返事が来ました。ドレッシングは別なので、勝手に全部かけず持っていきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 材料了承後に別ドレッシングを掛けず運ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: My friend replied that the ingredients are fine. The dressing is separate, so I will bring it without putting all of it on as I please.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: After the ingredients are approved, carry the separate dressing without pouring it on. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 必要な人数分は、こちらの量で足りそうですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Does this amount seem enough for the required number of people?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 二人で食べるのでこの一つにします。主菜を私が増やすのではなく、友人の献立に添える一品として渡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二人量一品を選び本人が主菜を増やすのでなく添えると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: There will be two of us eating, so I will take this one. I will give it as one dish to accompany my friend's menu, rather than adding more main dishes myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Choose one dish enough for two and say you are accompanying the menu, rather than increasing the main dishes yourself. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、その一品をお選びください。楽しいお食事を。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then please choose that dish. Enjoy your meal. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご家族の写真を撮る場所をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for a place to take a family photo?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 父がいつも撮る側です。今日は父も入った写真にしたいですが、父が写りたいか聞いてからお願いしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 撮影役の父も写真へ入れたいが本人希望を先聞くと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: My father is always the one taking photos. Today I would like a photo with him in it too, but I want to ask whether he wants to be photographed before requesting it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want your photographer father in the photo too but will first ask his preference. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご本人へ聞いてみてください。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 父は撮るのが好きだと言っています。無理に写る役を押し付けず、一枚だけなら入りたいか尋ねます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 撮るのが好きな父へ無理を求めず一枚参加可否を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: He says he likes taking photos. I will not force him to be a subject; I will ask whether he would like to join for just one photo.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Without pressuring your father who enjoys photography, ask whether he would join for one photo. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: よければ、こちらの背景でお二人が入れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: If you like, both of you can fit against this background.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 父が一枚ならよいと言いました。私の電話で友人に撮ってもらい、父のカメラは父に持ったままいてもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 父了承後に友人が本人電話で撮り父カメラは父保持と分担する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: My father said one photo is fine. I will have my friend take it with my phone, and my father will keep holding his own camera.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: After your father agrees, divide the roles so your friend uses your phone while your father keeps his camera. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 周囲の通行を空けて、短くお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please leave room for people to pass and keep it brief.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 通る人を待ってから一枚撮ります。父へ笑ってと繰り返し言わず、普段の顔でよいと伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 通行を待ち笑顔を強要せず一枚撮る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: We will wait for people to pass before taking one photo. I will tell my father his usual expression is fine, rather than repeatedly asking him to smile.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Wait for passersby and take one photo without forcing a smile. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 撮った後は、ここをほかの方へ譲ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: After taking it, please give other people a turn at this spot.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 撮れました。父にも見せて、気に入らなければ使わないと話します。場所を空け、今度は父が撮りたい景色を一緒に見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 写真を父へ見せ使用希望を確認し場所を譲り父の景色鑑賞へ戻る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: We got it. I will show my father too and say we will not use it if he does not like it. We will clear the spot and next look together at scenery he wants to photograph.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Show your father the photo and check his wishes about its use, give up the spot, and return to enjoying his chosen scenery. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、ご家族の時間をお楽しみください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26208-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then please enjoy your family time. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 列車の時刻を選び直すご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about choosing a different train time?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。用事が長引いて、予定していた便の出発に間に合いませんでした。行き先は同じで、今から乗れる便を探したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 用事が延び予定便に乗れず同目的地の次便を探したいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. My errand took longer, and I missed the departure of my planned train. My destination is the same, and I want to find a train I can board now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say your errand ran long, you missed the planned train, and you want a later service to the same destination. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お持ちの券の種類を確認します。こちらの券は、この区間の本日分です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will check your ticket type. This ticket is for this section today.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この区間で今日の便を探すのですね。席の予約はまだしていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 当日区間を確認し座席予約なしと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: So we are looking for a train on this section today. I have not reserved a seat yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm today's route section and say you have no seat reservation. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 今から乗れる候補はこちらです。早い便は乗換えがあり、後の便はそのまま行けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Here are the options you can board now. The earlier train requires a transfer; the later one goes directly.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 重い荷物がないので、乗換えのある早い便を選びたいです。乗換えの時間も教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 早い乗換便を選び接続時間を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have no heavy luggage, so I would like the earlier train with a transfer. Please also tell me the transfer time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Choose the earlier train requiring a transfer and ask about the connection time. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 接続はこの案内のとおりです。次の便へ間に合う経路をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: The connection is as shown here. I will explain a route that gets you to the next train in time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 乗換えの表示を控えました。途中で移るホームと、到着の見込みも確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 乗換表示を控え途中ホームと到着予定を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I noted the transfer information. I also want to confirm the platform I will change to along the way and the expected arrival time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Note the transfer information and ask about the intermediate platform and scheduled arrival. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 乗換え先のホームと到着予定は、この欄です。こちらの出発ホームからご乗車ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: The connecting platform and scheduled arrival are in this column. Please board from this departure platform.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 乗換えホームと到着予定を確認しました。次の便なら予定に合うので、この出発ホームへ向かいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 乗換ホームと到着予定を確認し選んだ便の出発ホームへ向かう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have checked the connecting platform and scheduled arrival. The next train suits my plans, so I will go to this departure platform.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the transfer platform and scheduled arrival, and go to the selected train's departure platform. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、よいご移動を。お気をつけてお進みください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then have a good journey. Please proceed carefully. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 行事で使う道具の貸出ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: This is about borrowing equipment for an event, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。机上の展示に使う台を三つ希望します。台の数が足りるか先に聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 展示台三つ貸出可能か問い合わせる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I would like three stands for a tabletop display. First I want to ask whether there are enough stands.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether three display stands are available to borrow. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 三つあるうち、一つは修理中です。この日には二つをご案内できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Of the three we have, one is under repair. We can offer two on that date.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 二つを使って展示を小さくします。修理中の台が当日に戻ると見込んで準備を進めるのはやめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 修理中一つを除く二つで展示縮小を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I will make the display smaller using two. I will stop preparing on the assumption that the stand under repair will return by the day.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Choose to reduce the display using the two stands other than the one under repair. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 展示する物の大きさは、二つの台へ収まりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Will the items you display fit on two stands?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 一つの大きい作品は今回は出さず、小さい四点に絞ると収まります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 大作品を外し小作品四点で台二つへ収める計画を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: If I leave out one large work this time and limit it to four small pieces, they will fit.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Describe a plan to leave out the large work and fit four small pieces on two stands. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: それでは二つの予約として確認します。受取りと返却の日を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Then I will confirm a reservation for two. Please tell me the pickup and return dates.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 前日に受け取り、行事翌日に返します。運ぶのは私と友人で、一度に二つを重ねず別々に持ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 前日受取翌日返却と二人別持ち運搬を指定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will collect them the day before the event and return them the day after. My friend and I will carry them separately, rather than stacking two at once.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Specify pickup the day before, return the day after, and separate carrying by two people. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その日程でお取りできます。こちらに予約内容を記しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: We can reserve them for those dates. I have written the reservation details here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 台二つ、前日受取り、翌日返却ですね。内容を確認しました。この台数で展示の配置を作ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 予約内容台数日程を確認し確定二台で配置作成と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Two stands, pickup the previous day, and return the following day, correct? I have checked the details. I will design the display layout for that number of stands.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the reserved number and dates and say you will design the layout with the two confirmed stands. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 予約を承りました。それでは、受取りの日にお待ちしています。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Your reservation is accepted. We will see you on the pickup day. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 寝具で、何か気になることはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is there anything bothering you about the bedding?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 枕カバーの折り返しが頬に当たります。枕を大きく変えるより、カバーの向きを整えていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 枕カバー折返しの頬接触を申告し枕変更でなく向き調整を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: The pillowcase fold touches my cheek. Rather than making a big change to the pillow, could you adjust the direction of the cover?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report the pillowcase fold touching your cheek and ask to adjust its direction rather than change the pillow. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 当たる部分を、指で示せますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Can you point to the part that touches you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この端です。右を向く時に頬へ触れます。カバーの裏返しを自分で繰り返していましたが、落ち着く向きが見つかりませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 当たる端と右向き時状況および本人調整不成功を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: This edge. It touches my cheek when I turn right. I kept turning the cover inside out myself, but could not find a comfortable orientation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Indicate the edge, the contact when facing right, and your unsuccessful adjustments. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: カバーを整える間、少し枕から離れていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Could you move a little away from the pillow while I straighten the cover?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 上体を起こして待ちます。寝具を替える間の姿勢はこちらでよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 調整中に起座待機し姿勢可否を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will sit up and wait. Is this posture all right while you change the bedding?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Sit up while waiting for the adjustment and check whether the posture is suitable. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: そのままで結構です。折り返しを反対へ向け、カバーを整えました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: That is fine. I turned the fold the other way and straightened the cover.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 顔を近づけると、さっきの端が当たりません。今の向きが楽です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 調整後に端接触なしと新向きの快適さを報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: When I bring my face close, that edge no longer touches it. This direction feels comfortable.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Report no edge contact after the adjustment and the comfort of the new orientation. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 枕自体の高さは、今のままでよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Is the pillow's own height all right as it is?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 高さは今のままでお願いします。カバーの向きだけ整えてもらえて助かりました。この状態で休みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 枕高さは維持しカバー向き調整を受け休息すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please keep the height as it is. It helped to have just the cover's direction adjusted. I will rest like this.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will retain the pillow height, accept the cover direction adjustment, and rest. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: そのままご利用ください。それでは、ゆっくりお休みください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please use it as it is. Then have a good rest. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 出来事について、お話を伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: I will hear your account of what happened.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 大きい買物袋が自転車のハンドルに当たり、他の方の自転車を倒しました。持主が見当たらず、その場を離れる前に相談に来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 買物袋を他人自転車へ当てて倒し持主不在で届けたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: My large shopping bag hit a bicycle's handlebar and knocked someone else's bicycle over. I could not find the owner, so I came to consult you before leaving the scene.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say your shopping bag struck and toppled someone else's bicycle and you want to report it because the owner is absent. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 倒れた場所と、ご自身の行動を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please tell me where it fell and what you did.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 駅前の駐輪場です。かごの角に傷が見えました。倒す前からの傷かは分かりませんが、自分が当てたことはお伝えします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 駅前位置と観察傷の発生時不明を本人衝突事実と分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: It is the bicycle parking area in front of the station. I saw a scratch on the basket corner. I do not know whether it was there before it fell, but I will report that I hit it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Separate the station-front location and unknown timing of the observed scratch from the fact that you struck the bicycle. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 今、自転車はどうなっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: What state is the bicycle in now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 起こして元の位置へ戻しました。元通り無傷だと確認したわけではないので、そのまま黙って帰りたくありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 車体を起こし元位置へ戻したが無傷保証でなく報告したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I stood it up and returned it to its original position. I have not confirmed it is back to its original, undamaged state, so I do not want to go home silently.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you stood the bicycle up and replaced it but cannot guarantee no damage and want to report it. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご連絡先と、持主へ伝えるための情報を伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will ask for your contact details and information to pass to the owner.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 私の名前と番号はこちらです。買物袋が当たった位置と、自転車を起こしたことを記録してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 本人氏名連絡先と当てた箇所起こした行動の記録を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Here are my name and number. Please record where the shopping bag hit and that I stood the bicycle up.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Give your name and contact details and ask to record the impact location and your action of standing it up. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 持主への確認方法を担当がご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: The person in charge will explain how to check with the owner.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 連絡方法を確認して待ちます。修理を私が勝手に進めず、持主が状況を確認できるよう自分の行動を説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 持主連絡方法を確認し無断修理せず本人行動を説明すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will confirm the contact method and wait. I will not arrange repairs on my own; I will explain my actions so the owner can check the situation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will confirm how to contact the owner, avoid unauthorized repairs, and explain your actions. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 状況を承りました。担当へ引き継ぎますので、失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: I have received your account. I will hand it over to the person in charge. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 配達状況をお調べしたいお手紙でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this a letter whose delivery status you want checked?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。相手がまだ見ていないと言うので来ました。発送時の控えは持っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 相手未確認の発送済便を発送控え持参で照会する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. The recipient said they have not seen it yet, so I came. I have the slip from when I sent it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Inquire about a sent letter the recipient has not seen, bringing the shipping slip. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 控えの番号で確認します。この記録では配達が済んでいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will check using the number on the slip. This record shows delivery is complete.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 配達済みなのですね。相手が内容を読んだという意味まで分かったわけではないのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 配達済みと内容既読は別と記録の範囲を確かめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: So it has been delivered. That does not mean you have established that the recipient has read its contents, does it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Check the record's scope, distinguishing delivered from contents read. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい、こちらで確認できるのは配達の記録です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Correct. What we can check here is the delivery record.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 記録の日は昨日でした。相手へ昨日配達済みと伝え、まず家の郵便物を確認してもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 昨日配達の結果を相手へ伝え家の郵便物確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: The recorded date was yesterday. I will tell the recipient it was delivered yesterday and first ask them to check the mail at home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Tell the recipient the result of delivery yesterday and ask them to check the household mail. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この問い合わせの結果を、控えへ書いておきましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Shall I write the result of this inquiry on your slip?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 日付と配達済みの記録をお願いします。控えをなくさず、相手の返事が来るまで保管します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 結果日時を控えへ記すよう求め原控え保管を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please write the date and the delivery-complete record. I will keep the slip without losing it until the recipient replies.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask for the result's date and time to be noted on the slip and say you will keep the original. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 記入しました。まだ見つからないとのことなら、この控えで改めてお問い合わせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: I have written it. If they still cannot find it, please inquire again with this slip.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 確認できた範囲が分かりました。未読だとすぐもう一通送るのでなく、配達の記録と相手の確認を分けて伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 未読だけで再送せず配達記録と相手確認を分けて報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I understand the scope of what was confirmed. Rather than immediately sending another letter just because it is unread, I will convey the delivery record separately from the recipient's confirmation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Do not resend merely because it is unread; report the delivery record and recipient's confirmation separately. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、控えをお返しします。ご確認ありがとうございました。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I will return your slip. Thank you for checking. Goodbye.
